The '''Altora system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained a single [[Star/Legends|sun]] that was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altora]]. The planet's surface featured plains and savannahs covered in tall [[Grass/Legends|grasses]] that were home to the [[altagak]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Limb/Legends|quadrupeds]].<ref name="Creatures" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Altora [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-3.<ref name="TEA" />
